policy: Every reference value used by the matrix must carry a repo-relative source file and a literal token that occurs in that file (zero hand-copy: the number is re-read from the frozen source, and the source sha256 is recorded).
Where the anchor is an analytic law the token is the formula string and 'value' is null; the case runner derives the number from the same law.
A reference that cannot be re-derived from an in-repo source keeps status pending (WITHHELD), it is never typed in by hand.

ghia_re100_u_center.quantity: u(0.5, 0.5) on the cavity vertical centreline, Re=100
ghia_re100_u_center.origin: Ghia, Ghia & Shin 1982, JCP 48:387, Table I (Re=100)

cylinder_cd_re100.quantity: mean drag coefficient of a circular cylinder, Re=100 (2-D)
cylinder_cd_re100.origin: Braza, Chassaing & Ha Minh 1986, JFM 165 (experiment Cd=1.35+-0.05)

cylinder_st_re100.quantity: Strouhal number of a circular cylinder, Re=100
cylinder_st_re100.value_token_note: token is a range ('0.164-0.165'); the single value 0.165 is the band centre, checked against the band instead of the literal

sphere_cd_re100.quantity: drag coefficient of a sphere, Re=100
sphere_cd_re100.origin: Schiller-Naumann correlation Cd=24/Re*(1+0.15 Re^0.687), cross-checked against Clift-Gauvin

tg2d_gamma_vel_theory.quantity: velocity decay rate of the 2-D Taylor-Green vortex gamma_vel = 2 nu k^2
tg2d_gamma_vel_theory.origin: analytic Taylor-Green solution; value frozen in the verified artifact as gamma_vel_theory

ritter_front_law.origin: Ritter 1892 self-similar shallow-water solution; implementation anchor in the library docstring

laplace_law_2d.formula: Delta p = sigma / R (2-D circular droplet)

blasius_cf_suboff.quantity: Blasius laminar flat-plate friction coefficient at Re=1000 (wetted-area normalization)
blasius_cf_suboff.origin: Blasius Cf = 1.328/sqrt(Re); frozen in the verified artifact as reference.Cf_ref

moser_channel_uplus.quantity: channel-flow mean velocity profile u+(y+) at Re_tau=180
moser_channel_uplus.reference_basis: DNS reference data (not in-repo -> tabular anchor WITHHELD)

chandrasekhar_rt.quantity: Rayleigh-Taylor linear growth rate sigma(k) for two viscous fluids
chandrasekhar_rt.origin: Chandrasekhar 1961, Hydrodynamic and Hydromagnetic Stability, ch. X

tg2d_gamma_e_theory.quantity: energy decay rate of the 2-D Taylor-Green vortex gamma_E = 4 nu k^2
tg2d_gamma_e_theory.origin: analytic Taylor-Green solution (energy decays twice as fast as velocity)
tg2d_gamma_e_theory.value_token_note: token is the formula; the numeric value is mirrored from the frozen artifact field gamma_e_theory
